verdict.rationale: Docs mention agents can 'ask for clarification' and 'report progress' via Slack, implying some bidirectional interaction, but there is no explicit documentation of sending follow-up/steering instructions to an already-running agent session without restarting it (e.g., no 'resume' or 'update task' API/CLI command shown). missing for 10: explicit API/CLI/SDK method for injecting mid-run instructions, documented behavior of an active session incorporating new prompts, and any hands-on confirmation that this works reliably.
